messages:
Rina: Who's up for a quick lobby boulder session + smoothie roulette at 12:30? Low-key, bring chalk if you use it. :climbing: :tropical_drink:
Omar: Count me in. Two problems max, then a 2k cooldown run? Depends on how my shoulders feel.
Zoe: Smoothie roulette?? Explain. :thinking:
Rina: Ill buy 3 smoothies. Each has a sticker under the lid with a silly dare (pushups, sing a chorus, do a cartwheel). Loser does the dare. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Tara: Hah. Im down if the dares are friendly. No cartwheels if it's wet.
Omar: If I get the singing dare Ill duet with whoever wins. :microphone:
Gym-bot: Event created: "Lobby boulder + smoothie roulette" @12:30 (45m). Reminder 10m prior.
Zoe: Quick logistic q: mats in the storage closet still? I can bring one but would rather not carry it.
Rina: Mats are there but please wipe them after. Chalk bucket near the left wall. No problem with light chalking.
Tara: Any climbers who want to warm up: easy traverse for 5 mins, then two easy top-outs. No sending attempts until weve warmed up.
Omar: Also bringing resistance band for shoulder activation.
Zoe: Ill do boulder only, gotta head to a 2pm call.
Rina: Final tally: boulder 3 (Rina, Omar, Zoe), cooldown run maybe 1 (Omar), spectator/cheer 1 (Tara).
Tara: Im the cheer + camera person. I promise tasteful photos only. :camera_with_flash:
Omar: Reminder for everyone: tidy up ropes and chalk, leave the lobby better than you found it.
Rina: Meetup: lobby by the plants at 12:25. Smoothies handed out after climbing. Winner picks a dare to assign.
Zoe: I'm bringing a small first aid kit just in case (blisters, tape).
Gym-bot: Weather note: clear skies, 19C. Indoor lanes open if we decide to move inside.
Rina: Awesome. See you all in 20! Post pics in #random after.
